scheme_name: नेशनल मिशन फॉर सस्टेनेबल एग्रीकल्चर अंतर्गत रेनफेड एरिया डेवलपमेंट
scheme_name_english: National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture - Rainfed Area Development
department: Kisan Kalyan and Agriculture Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
benefits: Supports integrated farming systems to increase farmers' income and reduce risks from drought, floods and adverse weather. The official MP scheme page states that assistance of up to ₹1,00,000 may be provided to one family for integrated farming on up to 2 hectares.
eligibility: Farmers of all categories can apply according to the official scheme information.
application_process: Beneficiaries are selected according to block targets through the Rural Agricultural Extension Officer and the Agriculture Department. Selection requires approval through the prescribed process.
source_type: MP Government CM Helpline Scheme Dashboard
